user-1.text: Draw how the app fits together, with a few charts.

text-2.markdown:
Here is how the app fits together, as diagrams and charts.

What happens when you type a prompt:

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[User types a prompt] --> B{Slash command?}
    B -->|yes| C[Run the command]
    B -->|no| D[Send to claude]
    D --> E[Stream events]
    E --> F[Render chat]
    C --> F
```

The messages between the three sides:

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant U as User
    participant Y as YellowCode
    participant C as claude
    U->>Y: types prompt
    Y->>C: user message
    C-->>Y: assistant stream
    C->>Y: can_use_tool
    Y->>U: permission band
    U->>Y: allow
    Y->>C: control_response
```

The session moves through these states:

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Idle
    Idle --> Streaming: prompt sent
    Streaming --> Waiting: permission asked
    Waiting --> Streaming: answered
    Streaming --> Idle: result
    Streaming --> Idle: Esc
```

The two sources share one interface:

```mermaid
classDiagram
    class Source {
        +start()
        +send(message)
        +stop()
    }
    class Replay {
        +speed: number
    }
    class Live {
        +process: Subprocess
    }
    Source <|-- Replay
    Source <|-- Live
```

And the stored data:

```mermaid
erDiagram
    SESSION ||--o{ MESSAGE : contains
    MESSAGE ||--o{ TOOL_CALL : has
    TOOL_CALL ||--o| TOOL_RESULT : returns
```

The UI sits on top of the binary:

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    UI[YellowCode UI] -->|stream-json| CLI[claude binary]
    CLI --> API[(Anthropic API)]
    CLI --> MCP[MCP servers]
    CLI --> Tools[Local tools]
```

Startup runs these steps in order:

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    A[parse args] --> B[read settings]
    B --> C[create renderer]
    C --> D[detect terminal]
    D --> E{kitty graphics?}
    E -->|no| F[pre-screen]
    E -->|yes| G[start theme]
    F --> G
    G --> H[load fixture]
    H --> I[replay events]
    I --> J[render chat]
```

A transition I could not finish:

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Idle
    Idle --> --> Streaming
    Streaming --> [*]
```

The areas of the app:

```mermaid
mindmap
  root((YellowCode))
    Chat
      Markdown
      Images
    Input
      Completion
      History
```

The plan for the next weeks:

```mermaid
gantt
    title Release plan
    dateFormat YYYY-MM-DD
    section Design
    Research        :done, r1, 2026-10-12, 3d
    Wireframes      :done, w1, after r1, 2d
    section Build
    Parser          :active, p1, after w1, 4d
    Renderer        :r2, after p1, 5d
    Theme colours   :crit, after p1, 2d
    section Ship
    Review          :after r2, 2d
    Release         :milestone, 2026-11-02, 0d
```

Where the context goes:

```mermaid
pie title Where the context goes
    "cache read" : 61.4
    "tool results" : 18.2
    "system prompt" : 9.7
    "user messages" : 5.1
    "assistant text" : 3.9
    "thinking" : 1.2
    "images" : 0.5
```

```mermaid
xychart-beta
    title "Render time per frame (ms)"
    x-axis [0.5.15, 0.6.0, 0.6.3, 0.6.6]
    y-axis "ms" 0 --> 12
    bar [9.8, 6.1, 5.4, 4.9]
```
